idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; qb's placement (head on worker 0, bank j on j % cores, the join on the last); not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. Actors are integers, a hand-off is one ring push and one ring pop, and there is no scheduler: the floor for the bank's filters and its fan-out and fan-in, not for finding the next actor
the producer, the source and the branches on worker 0, bank j on worker j % cores, the integrator, the combine and the sink on the last worker -- the placement qb gets
a round reaches the combine as an index into a table the integrator fills (the two share a worker): the least a message carrying `channels` values can be
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
